observations.content: The capture spool lives under the state directory, one folder per session.
The capture route answers on port 3850 and refuses a request without a token.
The store runs on Postgres only; the SQLite adapter was removed from tst-app.
The extraction worker takes live sessions before backfilled ones.
A release of tst-app is cut from main after the local CI passes.
